'''''Destination Alderaan''''' was a travel advertisement for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], displayed on an electronic billboard on a [[Hover taxi/Legends|hover taxi]] used by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] during a mission in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. The ad showed a [[Human/Legends|Human]] dressed in [[Color/Legends|white]] and standing in front of the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of [[Aldera]], accompanied by the words "DESTINATION ALDERAAN" written in white, [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters.<ref name="Lethal" />
